scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace @meddesk/server" "npm run dev --workspace @meddesk/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @meddesk/web && npm run build --workspace @meddesk/server
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @meddesk/server && npm run test --workspace @meddesk/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @meddesk/server && npm run typecheck --workspace @meddesk/web
